items.name: silently wrong aggregate — report Messages total counts only ACTIVE members' messages
items.change: `messages: Message.count` -> `messages: Message.joins(conversation: :user).where(users: { active: true }).count`. The headline 'Messages' total card now counts only messages that belong to conversations owned by ACTIVE users, instead of every message. The sibling totals (users, active_users, admins, conversations) are left on the full set, so the cards silently disagree once any user with messages is deactivated.
